title: Ourselves
summary: OURSELVES, plural of ourself. We or us, not others; added to we, by way of emphasis or opposition. We ourselves might distinctly number in words a great deal farther than we usually do. Safe in oursel

inlines.v: OURSELVES, plural of ourself. We or us, not others; added to we, by way of emphasis or opposition. We ourselves might distinctly number in words a great deal farther than we usually do. Safe in ourselves while on ourselves we stand.
